subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar accept a persistent, user-configurable local command-execution hook surface for quota and provider events after the argument round-trip defect is fixed?
rationale: Implementation review can verify safeguards, but only repository ownership can accept the long-term product, support, and security boundary of launching configured executables from background state transitions.

options.title: Approve hardened hooks
options.body: Accept the opt-in feature after exact argument round-trip coverage and final upgrade/security review.

options.title: Narrow to CLI/config
options.body: Remove the settings editor for now and expose the advanced hook contract only through explicit configuration and CLI tooling.

options.title: Decline command execution
options.body: Keep CodexBar observability-only and close the paired feature direction without launching external commands.

recommendation.title: Approve hardened hooks
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in feature after exact argument round-trip coverage and final upgrade/security review.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership makes this the best available owner for accepting a new persistent command-execution boundary.
